text.en: Clients highlight how eagerly their dogs visit Off The Leash in Stepps, with pets recognizing the arrival route and running straight in to greet their canine companions. Owners of breeds from small Brussels Griffons to larger dogs note that their pets return home pleasantly tired and cheerful after daycare and boarding stays. Reviewers express total peace of mind when leaving their pets.

Dog owners consistently praise the family-run team for their attentiveness, warmth, and reliable oversight. Multiple reviewers note that the staff treat every visiting pet like their own animal, providing thoughtful personal attention during daytime play and overnight boarding. Clients describe the team as dependable professionals who foster a safe and affectionate setting.

title.en: Secure grounds with enriching play areas

text.en: Reviewers commend the daycare and boarding facilities for providing an engaging and safe setting designed specifically for canine enrichment. Clients appreciate the spacious layout that allows dogs to explore freely, play with animal friends, and rest comfortably between outdoor activities. Pet parents describe the grounds as exceptionally well planned and maintained.

q.en: Does Off The Leash provide overnight boarding services?

a.en: Yes, clients report using the business for overnight and holiday boarding while traveling abroad.

q.en: Are both small and large dog breeds accommodated?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention bringing dogs ranging from small toy breeds like Brussels Griffons to larger pets.

q.en: Can puppies attend the daycare facility?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report enrolling puppies from around four months old for ongoing daytime care and socialization.

q.en: What activities are provided in the daycare area?

a.en: Clients describe a secure, canine-enriching play environment where dogs interact, exercise, and socialize safely.
